description: Presidential Secretariat - Notifying that Hon. Karunarathna Paranawithanage MP. has resigned the Office of the Deputy Minister of Provincial Councils & Local Government w.e.f. 03.12.2015 & appointed him as the Deputy Minister of Parliamentary Reforms & Mass Media w.e.f. 04.12.2015. Changed the portfolios of Hon. Mano Ganesan MP. as the Minister of National Co-existence, Dialogue & Official Languages w.e.f. 08.12.2015 & of Hon. Piyankara Jayaratna, MP. as the State Minister of Law & Order & Southern Development w.e.f. 11.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notifications about government personnel changes that include both the names of specific individuals (Hon. Karunarathna Paranavithanage, Hon. Mano Ganesan, MP, Hon. Piyankara Jayaratna, MP) AND detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios and responsibilities (e.g., "Deputy Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media," "Minister of National Co-existence, Dialogue and Official Languages," "State Minister of Law and Order and Prison Reforms"). This combination of named individuals with specific portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
